title.narrative: Strengthening sustainable food security, climate resilience and social cohesion for communities affected by the Sudan conflict.

description.narrative: Objective: Strengthening resilience, restoring sustainable livelihoods and promoting peaceful coexistence in communities affected by the Sudan conflict in Sudan and across the border in South Sudan.Outcome 1: Enhanced food and nutrition security through climate-adaptive agriculture, and diversified livelihood options.Outcome 2: Strengthened individual and community capacities to prevent, mitigate and respond to Gender Based Violence (GBV), safety threats and conflict.Outcome 3: Improved access to basic services (WASH facilities and services in schools and health facilities) and community infrastructure.Outcome 4: Enhanced adaptation and mitigation capacities to climate-related disasters.

The project directly targets 41,500 (22,198 female, 19,302 male, incl. 4150 persons with disabilities) conflict-affected and highly vulnerable project participants in Sudan, incl. women, girls, youth, persons with disabilities, returnees, internally displaced persons , and smallholder farmers and pastoralists who face limited access to land, inputs, services, and safe livelihood opportunities.

The proposed project aims to strengthen resilience and restore livelihoods while promoting peaceful coexistence for individuals affected by the Sudan conflict in both Sudan and South Sudan. By increasing food production and creating diversified income-generating opportunities, the project will enhance economic prospects for host communities and displaced populations in targeted areas. It will also focus on improving social integration and community cohesion, particularly by addressing the living conditions of women and girls and providing alternatives to violence for young men. Additionally, the project will invest in community-based infrastructure and assets that support livelihood activities, thereby fostering a more cohesive and resilient community.
